questions.question: Dr. Yassine faces an emergency: a patient needs immediate intervention. The material is not yet sterilized. What should he do?
options: Use the Flash cycle if available
Ask the patient to come back
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'In an emergency, the Flash cycle can be used. But beware, it does not allow storage.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine discovers that his autoclave displays a pressure error. Dr. Fatima tells him: 'You must not use it.' What is the first action to take?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'A pressure error is a serious signal. Technical service must be contacted before any use.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must manage a shortage of sterile packaging. Dr. Fatima offers an alternative. What is the best solution?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'Validated rigid containers are a safe alternative to classic packaging.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine notices that biological tests are sometimes positive. Dr. Fatima explains the possible causes. What is the most frequent cause?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'Overloading the autoclave is the most frequent cause of biological test failure.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must train a new assistant. Dr. Fatima advises him to show the procedures step by step. What is the first thing to show him?
options: The complete sterilization circuit (from dirty to sterile zone)
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'You must first show the complete circuit so he understands the entire chain.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine wonders about the effectiveness of different disinfectants. Dr. Fatima gives him a comparative table. Which disinfectant is most effective against spores?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'Peracetic acid is one of the few disinfectants with high sporicidal power.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must handle an incident: an instrument was used without being sterilized. Dr. Fatima explains the procedure to follow. What is the priority?
options: Inform the patient and take necessary measures
Wait to see if a problem occurs
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'Transparency is essential. The patient must be informed and corrective measures taken.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must optimize the sterilization flow in his office. Dr. Fatima suggests organizing the space. What is the best organization?
options: Do everything in the same room
Separate dirty, clean, and sterile zones
Do sterilization in the treatment room
Use a single room for everything
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'Separation of zones is essential to avoid cross-contamination.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must replace an autoclave. Dr. Fatima gives him selection criteria. What is the most important criterion?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'The most important criterion is compliance. An autoclave must be class B to treat hollow instruments.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine wonders about the storage of sterile instruments. Dr. Fatima explains that the shelf life depends on several factors. What is the main factor?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'The type of packaging is the main factor. Good packaging can preserve sterility for a long time.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must manage a suspected case of cross-contamination. Dr. Fatima explains the protocol to follow. What is the first action?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'The source of contamination must first be identified in order to act.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must explain the importance of daily tests to a new assistant. Dr. Fatima advises him to emphasize safety. Which test is the most important?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'The Bowie-Dick test is daily and essential for checking steam penetration.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine discovers that his osmosis water is contaminated. Dr. Fatima explains the risks. What is the main risk?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'Contaminated water can cause instrument corrosion.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must manage a workload peak. Dr. Fatima reminds him not to neglect sterilization. What is the main risk?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'Workload peaks must never compromise patient safety.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must choose between several instrument brands. Dr. Fatima gives him advice. What criterion should be prioritized?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'An instrument must be easy to clean and sterilize. It is a safety criterion.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must organize the traceability of sterilized batches. Dr. Fatima explains its importance. Why is traceability essential?
options: To be able to trace batches in case of a problem
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'Traceability allows tracing a batch in case of an incident. It is a legal obligation.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must manage an immunocompromised patient. Dr. Fatima reminds him that precautions are reinforced. What additional measure should be taken?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'For an immunocompromised patient, it is preferable to use disposable instruments.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must replace his washer-disinfector. Dr. Fatima gives him advice. What is the most important characteristic?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'The thermal disinfection program is essential to guarantee safety.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine wonders about the use of ethylene oxide. Dr. Fatima explains that this process is reserved for certain uses. Which materials require ethylene oxide?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'Ethylene oxide is used for heat-sensitive instruments that cannot withstand heat.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must handle a case of suspected prion. Dr. Fatima explains the special precautions. What measure should be taken?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'Prions are resistant. Prolonged sterilization at 134°C is necessary.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must evaluate the effectiveness of his sterilization system. Dr. Fatima suggests a control method. What is the most reliable method?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'Biological tests are the most reliable method because they directly check the destruction of microorganisms.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must manage a contamination outbreak in his office. Dr. Fatima explains the emergency protocol. What is the first measure?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'The contaminated area must first be isolated to prevent spread.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must prepare instruments for complex surgery. Dr. Fatima reminds him of the importance of packaging. What type of packaging is recommended?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'For complex surgeries, double packaging is recommended for maximum safety.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine must update the sterilization protocol. Dr. Fatima advises him to consult official recommendations. Which reference should be followed?
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'ISO standards are the reference for sterilization protocols.'

questions.question: Dr. Yassine, after handling several complex situations, receives congratulations from Dr. Fatima: 'You are ready for the Expert level.' What is the next step?
options: Become a trainer for new interns
questions.explanation: Dr. Fatima explains: 'You are now capable of training, innovating, and participating in the scientific community. The Expert level awaits you.'
